method: Generated from the Almanac shelf, which is itself built from the IRS 990 corpus and a hand-curated opportunity register. Eligibility is decided by the shelf and read here, never recomputed. tiers.conduit: Peer prospect whose giving spans 20 or more NTEE sectors at under 25 percent focus in this client's band; reads as a donor-advised or community-foundation conduit rather than a programmatic funder (matcher value, almanac_match.prospective_funders()).
tiers.tier_1_strong: Peer prospect with 60 percent or more of its giving in this client's NTEE band across 10 or more in-state peers (matcher value).
tiers.tier_2_promising: Peer prospect with 30 percent or more of its giving in this client's NTEE band across 3 or more in-state peers (matcher value).
tiers.tier_3_weak: Peer prospect below those thresholds (matcher value).
tiers.null: Prior-funder rows carry no matcher tier; the matcher tiers peer prospects only.

provenance.prior_funder_exact: Confirmed prior funder, joined on recipient EIN in IRS Form 990 Schedule I.
provenance.prior_funder_named_review_required: Possible prior funder by name match in 990-PF Part XV, which carries no recipient EIN; awaiting a recorded identity review, so it is rendered as a placeholder, never as a match.
provenance.prior_funder_named_confirmed: Prior funder by 990-PF Part XV name match whose identity a recorded, dated, named review has confirmed.
